lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular spots arranged in at least four identifiable horizontal rows. The spots in the upper rows exhibit higher pixel intensity and more defined edges compared to the lower rows, which appear more diffused and lower in contrast.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are visible, creating a grid-like intersection pattern where the high-luminance blobs serve as anchor nodes, particularly evident in the mid-lateral region of the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible running horizontally. They are defined by a sharp intensity gradient, with highlights on the superior edge and a distinct shadow cast on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora (Echeneidae) is attached to the lower lateral-ventral region of the shark, positioned just above the pectoral fin.
